meta.name: Sagar's CAD Studio - Jewellery Master Database
meta.compatibility: Gemvision Matrix 9 / MatrixGold 4 workflows (values are reference data to type or compare; not a Matrix library file)
meta.how_to_edit: Add or edit entries inside the libraries. The app reads label/name/aliases fields. Keep ids unique. Put the file next to index.html as jewellery_master_db.json and the app will load it instead of its built-in copy.

status_legend.typical_reference_range: Typical published range; individual samples vary.
status_legend.commercial_convention: Trade/shop convention, not an international standard.
status_legend.approximation: Calculated or rounded; verify before production.
status_legend.estimate: Estimated by this database (rule of mixtures). Replace with supplier data.
status_legend.supplier_specific: Depends on your supplier or alloy; left blank on purpose.
status_legend.practical_starting_preset: CAD starting value only; not a manufacturing standard.

meta.disclaimer: Carat weights are estimates; actual weight depends on cut proportions and depth. Densities of gold, platinum and silver alloys depend on supplier alloy recipes. Verify critical dimensions on a mandrel or with your supplier before production.

sources.title: ISO 8653 - Jewellery: Ring sizes
sources.use: Ring size = inside circumference in mm (ISO/EU sizing). Indian size rule below is a commercial convention built on it.

sources.title: ISO 9202 - Jewellery: Fineness of precious metal alloys
sources.use: Standard fineness marks (gold 375/585/750/916/958/999, platinum 850/900/950, palladium 500/950, silver 800/925/958/999).

sources.title: Standard gemmological property tables (specific gravity, Mohs hardness ranges)
sources.use: Gemstone SG and hardness. Values are typical ranges; individual stones vary.

sources.title: Trade weight-estimation factors (L x W x depth x factor)
sources.use: Approximate carat estimates. Actual weight depends on cut proportions and depth.

sources.title: Matrix 9 / MatrixGold 4 material densities as already used in the app (user's data)
sources.use: Densities for gold/platinum/silver alloys. Verify against your own Matrix material library and supplier datasheet.

sources.title: Practical CAD / bench starting presets (commercial convention)
sources.use: Starting values only. Not mandatory manufacturing standards. Confirm with your caster/setter.

sources.title: Estimated by rule of mixtures (this database)
sources.use: Where no reliable published density exists, density is estimated from the metal fractions. Marked status=estimate. Replace with supplier data.

ring.flag: Check on mandrel when US or UK nearest size differs from the measured diameter by more than 0.10 mm

gemstone.carat: L x W x depth x vol_k x SG / 200
gemstone.note: Diamond basis uses SG 3.52. 1 ct = 0.2 g.

metal.note: Theoretical solid weight from CAD volume; ignores shrinkage, porosity and finishing loss.
